title: Mareechika
plot_overview: A village girl claims that a man has been murdered, setting off a tense chain of events. As a US-returned woman enters his life, relationships shift and a murder investigation begins to unravel what really happened.
will_you_like_this: If you enjoy mystery-driven dramas with relationship pressure and a murder investigation, you may like Mareechika; Not for you if you want light, romance-first stories without investigation tension.
review_summary: Pros: tense mystery setup; shifting relationships; village-to-outside intrigue | Cons: unclear motivations at times; investigation pace feels uneven
